algorithm: Dataset baselines: CAPTRA/BundleTrack/ICP (category-level object/part pose tracking), PSTNet/P4Transformer (4D point-cloud segmentation), MS-TCN/MS-TCN++/ASFormer (action segmentation, I3D features). Appendix D feasibility study: SAC (RL) vs GAIL (IL, using SAC internally), both with a PointNet+Transformer backbone, on a SAPIEN/ManiSkill-style 'Pick Up' task with a 30-DoF Adroit Hand
hand: MANO (human capture, single-hand only); Appendix D retargets to a 30-DoF Adroit Hand via DexMV-inspired task-space-vector optimization
sim: SAPIEN (ManiSkill-style environment, timestep 0.05) — Appendix D only
success_criterion: Toy car brought to a target height and held static for a period; episode time limit 200 steps (Appendix D.1, Pick Up task)
headline_metric: Success rate (%) on Pick Up task (Adroit Hand, toy-car category), 3 random seeds
headline_value: GAIL 17.4% (std 7.9) vs SAC 3.5% (std 3.2) (Table 10, App. D.3) — a single-category, 12-demo feasibility demo, not a general benchmark
human_data: 2.4M RGB-D egocentric frames, 4,000 sequences, participant count contradicts internally (Abstract states 4 participants, Sec 1 states 9), 800 object instances (16 categories) across 610 rooms; MANO single-hand pose + category-level 9D object/part pose + action-segmentation labels. Appendix D retargets HOI4D MANO (51-DoF) hand poses to a 30-DoF Adroit Hand via DexPilot-style task-space-vector optimization, using 12 hand-selected high-quality demonstrations as GAIL's expert trajectories.
paper_code_mismatch: Code repo (github.com/leolyliu/HOI4D-Instructions) contains only dataset-format definitions, segmentation label lists, task definitions and 4D-segmentation preparation scripts, not the data itself (data hosted separately at www.hoi4d.top); a LICENSE file exists in the repo tree but its text content was not captured, so licence type is not stated.
note_gaps: Two internal numeric contradictions: participant count is '4' in the Abstract vs '9' in Sec 1 body text; task count is '54' in Sec 4 vs '76' in App A.3. The Contact loss L_Contact equation (App A.4) is an unrendered PDF image and its functional form was not captured. HOI4D is explicitly single-hand-per-sequence only (authors' own stated limitation), so it is not a bimanual/two-hands-jointly-annotated corpus.
